<sub>Task read 2026-11-27 23:05 UTC · re-checked on request at `356d797`</sub>

| | Requirement | In this PR |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ **MET** | AC1: `monthlyAttendance(records, month)` counts only the records whose date falls in the given month (format YYYY-MM). <sub>AC01</sub> | `src/attendance/monthly.ts:14` · Filters the records by date prefix matching the given YYYY-MM month, so only records from that month are counted. |
| ✅ **MET** | AC 2: it returns the number of present days and the number of absent days. <sub>AC02</sub> | `src/attendance/monthly.ts:15`, `src/attendance/monthly.ts:16` · Counts the present records and derives the absent count from the remaining records of the month, and returns both. |
| 🟡 **PARTIAL** | AC3: it returns the attendance rate as a percentage rounded to one decimal, and 0 when there are no records in the month. <sub>AC03</sub> | `src/attendance/monthly.ts:17` · The rate is computed as a percentage rounded to one decimal, but when the month has no records the division is by zero and the returned rate is not 0; there is no guard for the empty-month case. · **Do:** Return a rate of 0 when there are no records in the month, for example by checking the month's record count before dividing. · _was met_ |
